mapper.select: select uc.id, uc.coupon_id, c.title, c.discount_amount, c.min_amount, c.type, c.seckill_end_time, uc.status, uc.create_time from user_coupon uc left join coupon c on c.id = uc.coupon_id where uc.user_id = #{userId} order by uc.create_time desc
